One day, after another long session of shitposting on your favorite Norwegian Deep-Sea Basket Weaving imageboard, you realize you're out of snacks and head out to restock. On the way back, you're stopped by a nun handing out pamphlets for service at a church you've never heard of. 

In a fit of uncharacteristic adventurousness, you decide to check it out, partially motivated by the fact that the nun was pretty cute. The address on the pamphlet leads you to a surprisingly pristine stone church, and despite being very near your home you don't think you've ever seen it before. There are only a few other people attending, but you put aside your misgivings and head in. The moment you step foot in the church, you feel the blood rush to your head and your vision blacks out. 

After a long restless period of unconsciousness, filled with waves of burning heat washing over your body, you awake. Slowly looking around, the first thing you notice is that you're in a dim windowless stone room, tapestries on the walls and lit only by candles, laying on a stone alter. The second thing you notice is that you're stark naked, and looking down you have a massive, rock hard, foot long throbbing erection. Looking around once more, you notice a group of nuns all kneeling together and watching you intently, with one at the front standing to speak.
